title: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1LD: pulses and defects; halts iff a pulse meets 000 (observed)
text: Runs of one or two 1s with single 0s between them are transparent to the head's round trips, so each round trip is a pulse to the first defect: a run of k ≥ 6 ones loses 3, runs of 4 and 5 dissolve, 1^3 becomes 00, and an inner 000 halts the machine (random tests). Epochs end at 00 pulses, whose result depends on the words near them. No pulse meets a 000 in 3·10^10 steps.
